'''R5-M2'''<ref name="EYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> was an [[astromech droid]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ESB" /> The [[droid]] was programmed to calculate optimal evacuation trajectories.<ref name="BB-8 and others">{{EncyclopediaCite|BB-8 and Other Astromech Droids}}</ref> When the Alliance lost a [[Battle of Hoth|battle]] to the Empire on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]],<ref name="ESB" /> R5-M2 helped evacuate Rebel personnel from [[Echo Base]].<ref name="EYNTK" /> The [[droid]] had [[Color|black]], blue and white plating.<ref name="ESB" />
